description: This file contains shell functions for migrating LED sysfs configurations and applying migrations within an OpenWRT system. It defines functions to update or remove sysfs entries for LEDs and to apply configuration changes.

methods.name: migrate_led_sysfs
methods.description: Updates sysfs entries for LEDs based on provided configuration and tuples.

methods.name: remove_devicename_led_sysfs
methods.description: Removes device name prefix from sysfs entries for LEDs unless exceptions match.

methods.name: migrate_leds
methods.description: Loads system configuration and applies led sysfs migrations.

methods.name: remove_devicename_leds
methods.description: Loads system configuration and removes device name prefixes from LED sysfs entries.

methods.name: migrations_apply
methods.description: Commits configuration changes for a specified realm if there are pending changes.
